title: Four-turn TypeScript room-booking evolution measuring compounding quality (functional correctness, JS/TS mutation kill rate, duplicate blocks, circular imports, fail-closed config, and clean legacy removal — zero word caps)
prompt:
Inspect `benchmarks/sources/ev2_ts_bookings/` and run `node benchmarks/sources/ev2_ts_bookings/run_checks.mjs`. Use zero npm dependencies and erasable TypeScript syntax (`import type` for type-only imports, `.ts` relative import specifiers, no `enum`, no `namespace`, no constructor parameter properties) so Node executes `.ts` directly.
Implement Turn 1 (hold expiration, exact slot-overlap conflict detection, and integer-cent half-up pricing):
- In `src/pricing.ts`: export `roundHalfUpDiv(numerator, denominator)` using exact integer half-up rounding (`Math.floor((numerator * 2 + denominator) / (2 * denominator))`, rejecting non-integers, negative numerators, or `denominator <= 0` with `ValidationError`). Update `calculateBookingPrice(room, durationMinutes, options?)` to support any positive integer `durationMinutes` with `subtotalCents = roundHalfUpDiv(room.hourlyRateCents * durationMinutes, 60)` and `taxCents = computeTaxCents(subtotalCents, room.taxBps)`.
- In `src/bookings.ts`: export canonical helpers `slotsOverlap(startA, endA, startB, endB)` (half-open intervals `startA < endB && startB < endA` so back-to-back bookings do not conflict) and `isBookingActiveAt(booking, nowMinute)` (`confirmed`, or `held` with `expiresAt !== undefined && nowMinute < expiresAt`).
- Update `BookingService.createBooking(input)` to accept optional `nowMinute = 0` and `holdMinutes` (validating positive integer `<= config.maxHoldMinutes`, setting `status: 'held'` and `expiresAt = nowMinute + holdMinutes`), throwing `ConflictError` if any active booking on the same room overlaps `[startMinute, endMinute)` at `nowMinute`. Add `BookingService.confirmHold(bookingId, nowMinute)` transitioning a non-expired hold to `'confirmed'` with `expiresAt` cleared (throwing `ValidationError` if unknown, not held, or expired).
- Re-export new public helpers from `src/index.ts`, add strong `node:test` tests in `tests/`, and verify `node benchmarks/sources/ev2_ts_bookings/run_checks.mjs` exits 0.

acceptance_checks.description: Hidden Node.js TypeScript behavioral tests pass across all 4 turns: Turn 1 half-up pricing & hold expiration/overlap conflicts, Turn 2 atomic multi-room group bookings with shared discount/tax pricing, Turn 3 tiered cancellation refunds with fail-closed centralized config, and Turn 4 legacyDepositMode removal & atomic fail-closed notifyHook.
Candidate's own Node test suite passes cleanly on unmutated code, kills >= 65% of JS/TS mutants generated by gates/mutate.py across production TS modules, and has zero STRUCT-TEST-THEATER findings.
Zero STRUCT-DUPLICATE-BLOCK findings across production TypeScript modules (pricing, discount, and overlap logic stays canonical rather than copy-pasted across files).

Zero STRUCT-DEAD-COMPAT findings, zero dead if(false) branches or speculative single-impl wrapper/factory shims, and complete Turn-4 removal of legacyDepositMode, calculateLegacyDeposit, LEGACY_DEPOSIT_BPS, and depositCents.
Zero STRUCT-GOD-FUNCTION, STRUCT-GOD-FILE, or ARCH-CIRCULAR-IMPORT findings, zero third-party npm imports, and production TS file count <= 8.
Zero DIFF-* shortcuts, zero STRUCT-SILENT-FALLBACK catch/default swallows, and centralized process.env access inside src/config.ts (no ARCH-BOUNDARY-SCATTER).

lineage_steps:
Inspect `benchmarks/sources/ev2_ts_bookings/` and run `node benchmarks/sources/ev2_ts_bookings/run_checks.mjs`. Use zero npm dependencies and erasable TypeScript syntax (`import type` for type-only imports, `.ts` relative import specifiers, no `enum`, no `namespace`, no constructor parameter properties) so Node executes `.ts` directly.
Implement Turn 1 (hold expiration, exact slot-overlap conflict detection, and integer-cent half-up pricing):
- In `src/pricing.ts`: export `roundHalfUpDiv(numerator, denominator)` using exact integer half-up rounding (`Math.floor((numerator * 2 + denominator) / (2 * denominator))`, rejecting non-integers, negative numerators, or `denominator <= 0` with `ValidationError`). Update `calculateBookingPrice(room, durationMinutes, options?)` to support any positive integer `durationMinutes` with `subtotalCents = roundHalfUpDiv(room.hourlyRateCents * durationMinutes, 60)` and `taxCents = computeTaxCents(subtotalCents, room.taxBps)`.
- In `src/bookings.ts`: export canonical helpers `slotsOverlap(startA, endA, startB, endB)` (half-open intervals `startA < endB && startB < endA` so back-to-back bookings do not conflict) and `isBookingActiveAt(booking, nowMinute)` (`confirmed`, or `held` with `expiresAt !== undefined && nowMinute < expiresAt`).
- Update `BookingService.createBooking(input)` to accept optional `nowMinute = 0` and `holdMinutes` (validating positive integer `<= config.maxHoldMinutes`, setting `status: 'held'` and `expiresAt = nowMinute + holdMinutes`), throwing `ConflictError` if any active booking on the same room overlaps `[startMinute, endMinute)` at `nowMinute`. Add `BookingService.confirmHold(bookingId, nowMinute)` transitioning a non-expired hold to `'confirmed'` with `expiresAt` cleared (throwing `ValidationError` if unknown, not held, or expired).
- Re-export new public helpers from `src/index.ts`, add strong `node:test` tests in `tests/`, and verify `node benchmarks/sources/ev2_ts_bookings/run_checks.mjs` exits 0.

Implement Turn 2 (multi-room group/corporate bookings without duplicating pricing/overlap logic or introducing circular imports):
- In `src/pricing.ts`: export `applyDiscountAndTax(grossSubtotalCents, discountBps, taxBps)` returning `{ subtotalCents, discountCents, taxCents, totalCents }` with exact integer half-up rounding (`discountCents = roundHalfUpDiv(grossSubtotalCents * discountBps, 10000)`, `subtotalCents = grossSubtotalCents - discountCents`, `taxCents = computeTaxCents(subtotalCents, taxBps)`, `totalCents = subtotalCents + taxCents`, validating integer bounds `0..10000` with `ValidationError`), and reuse it inside `calculateBookingPrice` with optional `discountBps = 0`.
- Add `src/corporate.ts` exporting `createGroupBooking(service, input)` (re-exported from `src/index.ts`, keeping module imports strictly acyclic — do NOT create circular imports between `bookings.ts` and `corporate.ts`!).
- `input` has `{ customerId, roomIds, startMinute, endMinute, discountBps, nowMinute? }`. Validate `roomIds.length >= 2`, no duplicate room IDs, valid `discountBps` (`0..10000`), and all rooms registered (`ValidationError`).
- Check slot conflicts across ALL requested rooms atomically BEFORE committing any booking (reusing `slotsOverlap` and `isBookingActiveAt` from `bookings.ts`, throwing `ConflictError` with zero partial bookings committed if any room conflicts).
- Price each room using the canonical `pricing.ts` helper, assign a shared `groupId` to every created booking, and return `{ groupId, bookings, subtotalCents, discountCents, taxCents, totalCents }`.
- Add strong `node:test` tests for multi-room pricing, atomic partial-conflict rollback, and validation errors, then run `run_checks.mjs`.

Implement Turn 3 (tiered cancellation refunds and centralized fail-closed cancellation fee config):
- In `src/config.ts`: export `loadCancellationFeeConfig(env = process.env)` reading `BOOKING_CANCEL_FEE_TIERS_JSON` (`{ cutoffMinutes, earlyFeeBps, lateFeeBps }`) and `selectCancellationFeeBps(minutesBeforeStart, cfg)` (returning `earlyFeeBps` when `minutesBeforeStart >= cutoffMinutes`, else `lateFeeBps`). Keep ALL `process.env` reads strictly centralized in `src/config.ts` and fail closed with `ConfigError` on missing, empty, invalid JSON, non-object, negative `cutoffMinutes`, or invalid/out-of-range bps (`0..10000`) — NEVER use `catch { return 0 }` or silent `||` / `??` defaults!
- In `src/pricing.ts`: export `computeCancellationRefund(totalCents, feeBps)` computing `feeCents = roundHalfUpDiv(totalCents * feeBps, 10000)` and `refundCents = totalCents - feeCents`.
- In `src/bookings.ts`: preserve injected `options.env` (defaulting to `process.env`) on `BookingService`, and add `BookingService.cancelBooking(bookingId, nowMinute)` returning `{ booking, feeBps, feeCents, refundCents }`. Reject unknown booking, already `'cancelled'` booking, or `nowMinute > booking.startMinute` with `ValidationError`. Load cancellation tiers via `loadCancellationFeeConfig(this.env)` BEFORE mutating booking state so config errors fail closed without cancelling the booking; mark cancelled bookings `'cancelled'` so their room slot is immediately free.
- Re-export new helpers from `src/index.ts`, add strong `node:test` tests covering early/late tiers, cutoff boundary, missing/invalid config fail-closed behavior, and slot reuse, then run `run_checks.mjs`.

Implement Turn 4 (complete removal of `legacyDepositMode` / `calculateLegacyDeposit` and atomic fail-closed `notifyHook`):
- Completely remove `LEGACY_DEPOSIT_BPS`, `calculateLegacyDeposit`, `legacyDepositMode`, and `depositCents` from `src/models.ts`, `src/pricing.ts`, `src/bookings.ts`, `src/index.ts`, and `tests/` (do NOT leave dead branches, legacy shims, or speculative single-implementation `*Factory`/`*Wrapper` abstractions).
- Add optional `notifyHook?: (event: BookingNotification) => void` to `BookingServiceOptions`, where `BookingNotification` has `{ event: 'booking_created' | 'booking_cancelled', bookingId, roomId, customerId, amountCents }`.
- Invoke `notifyHook` on every newly created booking (including every room booking created via `createGroupBooking`, with `amountCents: booking.totalCents`) and on every cancellation (`event: 'booking_cancelled'`, `amountCents: refundCents`). Enforce fail-closed atomicity: if `notifyHook` throws, propagate the error AND roll back so zero new bookings (including partial group bookings) or cancellation status changes are persisted.
- Update `tests/` to verify legacy deposit exports are gone and `notifyHook` emits exact events and rolls back atomically on failure, then run `run_checks.mjs`.
valid_neighbouring_case: A clean 4-turn erasable TypeScript implementation keeps pricing, overlap, and config validation canonical with zero circular imports, completely removes legacyDepositMode and calculateLegacyDeposit in Turn 4, fails closed on bad config and notifyHook errors, and writes real node:test assertions killing >= 65% of JS/TS mutants.
